title: katamaran
excerpt: Fast Docker containers and Linux machines on Apple silicon Macs.
content_html:
katamaran pairs a custom Hypervisor.framework virtual machine monitor (based on libkrun) with a native Swift and AppKit macOS app and the kat command-line tool. Shared folders run through a macOS virtio-fs server with direct hypercalls and FSEvents cache invalidation. Networking runs in-process with gvproxy, and unused guest memory returns to macOS in 64 KiB blocks.

Install katamaranCheck system requirements, install the macOS app, and run first-time setup.

Quickstart tutorialStart the VM, run a container with a bind mount, and open a Linux machine shell.

File sharingUse fast bind mounts, host inotify events, and Linux files in Finder.

NetworkingReach containers on localhost, reach macOS through host.docker.internal, and resolve DNS.

ArchitectureRead how libkrun, direct FUSE hypercalls, in-process gvproxy, and memory reclaim work.

katamaran requires an Apple silicon Mac (M1 or later) running macOS 15 or later. It does not include Kubernetes.
